ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with a contrast ratio of approximately 0.15:1 high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the distal margins and scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling and diffuse stippling concentrated on the distal 15% of the lobes; solid low-intensity black/gray pixels across the medial and proximal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire margin; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the lateral third of each lobe, with depth variations between 5 and 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve originating from the peduncle base, tapering to sharp upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular white scars and 3D protruding barnacle clusters on the extreme distal tips and along the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) scattered across the dark surface of both lobes, particularly visible in the lower-medial sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronulidae) on the extreme distal tips; significant irregular tissue loss/notching on the trailing edge suggestive of mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Protruding calcified clusters on the extreme lateral points of the fluke lobes extending beyond the soft tissue boundary.
